title: Pineapple prawn coconut curry
summary: Pineapple prawn coconut curry is a thai dinner built around raw king prawns and pineapple, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Pineapple prawn coconut curry. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add raw king prawns and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and pineapple.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until light coconut milk is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Pineapple prawn coconut curry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Pineapple prawn coconut curry.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
